description: This Kotlin source file contains internal functions related to network hostname analysis, specifically for determining if a given host is a loopback or private LAN gateway. It includes logic to parse IP addresses, check for local network ranges, and detect emulator environments.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks whether a host string refers to a loopback gateway, considering IPv4, IPv6, and emulator-specific addresses.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if a host string refers to a private LAN address, including local network ranges and loopback addresses.

methods.name: isAndroidEmulatorRuntime
methods.description: Detects whether the current environment is an Android emulator or test framework based on device build properties.

methods.name: parseIpv4Address
methods.description: Parses a string as an IPv4 address and returns the corresponding byte array if valid.

methods.name: isIpv6LiteralChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid within an IPv6 literal hostname.
